//: The values below target the local docker-compose stack and are intentionally worthless:
they protect nothing and must never be reused in a shared environment.
For anything beyond a developer machine, supply Database:ConnectionString,
Authentication:Jwt:SigningKey, WhatsApp:AppSecret and the Bootstrap credentials from
user secrets or the platform secret store, and leave them empty here.

Smtp.//: Password lives in user secrets: dotnet user-secrets set "Smtp:Password" "<app password>" --project src/Marketing.API

Security.//: A fixed, published development key. It is worthless by design - anything encrypted with it is readable by anyone holding this file.

Email.//: Points invitation and reset links at the Angular app, which now serves /auth/accept-invitation and /auth/reset-password. Set this to https://localhost:7108/api/v1/dev to fall back to the development helper pages when the front end is not running.
